assertions.name: vdW bar-odd residual is REAL at real q₀ (P_skew, not Im(q))
assertions.source: rem-im-q-vs-p-skew: P_skew is real at real q

description: Narrowed van der Waals probe (formalize-first; Lean prop:vdw-pskew-isolation sorry-free). The Hopf link σ₁²=q²e₊+q⁻²e₋ splits under the bar involution into 2cosh(2λ)·𝟙 (bar-even, retained P_avg carrier) + 2sinh(2λ)·(e₊−e₋) (bar-odd, the P_skew/Coulomb-EM channel the canonical projection discards). vdW IS that bar-odd residual sinh(2λ)·(e₊−e₋) — an exact q-expression, NOT an h^k fit nor a cosh factor on the covalent ladder (the earlier 0.81 was the wrong sinh⁴/covalent framing). Per rem-im-q-vs-p-skew the residual is REAL at real q (P_skew), not Im(q). α_EM Habiro [2]_q(1−h²α)=2cosh λ(1−h²α) is the bar-EVEN sibling (cosh carrier × sinh² correction); vdW is bar-ODD (sinh·cosh) — same machinery, opposite sector. Open: the archimedean 1/r⁶ separation scaling the fibre residual to the molecular vdW energy (not fitted).

data.finding: van der Waals is the bar-odd (sinh / P_skew) residual of the Hopf link: 2σ₁² = 2cosh(2λ)·𝟙 + 2sinh(2λ)·(e₊−e₋), with the cosh part the retained P_avg carrier and the sinh·(e₊−e₋)=0.1062 part the discarded Coulomb-EM channel = vdW. This narrows the probe to the EXACT bar-odd q-expression (no h^k fit, no cosh-on-covalent factor). The residual is real at real q (P_skew ≠ Im(q)). Lean prop:vdw-pskew-isolation proves the decomposition sorry-free. α_EM Habiro is the bar-even sibling. Open: the archimedean 1/r⁶ separation to the molecular energy (not fitted).
